race.description: Mark Kirchner Food Services Mdn Plate
race.comment: COMPASSION (11) is a colt by Frankel who debuts for the Busuttin & Young stable. He looked good winning a recent Cranbourne jumpout and this looks a very winnable maiden first time out over a suitable trip. Expecting him to measure right up. JUST MY LOT (8) presents third up. She battled away fresh at Hamilton before just finding one better here last time out over this trip. Fitter again and should take plenty of catching. CAPTAIN REDBEARD (1) ran a good race first up at Seymour when getting back and running into third. He's lightly raced and could settle closer here from the soft gate. BELLE FLAMME (6) resumes. She was improving last time in over a bit further and can run a good race fresh. PAPPA RITCH (4) comes back in trip which can suit.
